event_name: Date 08 June 2019 Time 18:12 2019 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 6 - 9 June 2019 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 16 went to the right of the bollard at turn 9 contrary to the Race Directors Note no 9.1 (document 2).
offence: Breach of Article 12.1.1.i of the FIA International Sporting Code.
penalty: Deletion of the relevant lap time (in accordance with Article 31.4 of the FIA F1 Sporting Regulations).
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence, heard from the driver of car 16 (Charles Leclerc) and the team representative.
